name: ato
description: Advanced Tab Organizer - Kill duplicate tabs instantly
author: Jean Lucas Lima

scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run typecheck && vite build --mode unpacked
scripts.build:store: npm run icons && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.zip: npm run build:store && cd dist && zip -r ../ato-v$(node -p "require('../package.json').version").zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
